subject: [video] WP01 C1 evidence: plug-in load commands, weak imports, ad-hoc signature
body:
Three checks the lead can use for cycle C1 (all on build/ios/Slim.videoencoder as it stands; nothing run on the phone).

1) Load commands (llvm-objdump --macho --dylibs-used): libSystem and CoreFoundation normal, VideoToolbox weak, NOTHING else. build_ios.sh now passes -weak_library for every non-libSystem/CoreFoundation TBD and -dead_strip_dylibs, so the plug-in no longer drags AudioToolbox/ImageIO/CoreGraphics/CoreMedia/CoreVideo load commands it does not use (they are weak once avc/ brings CoreMedia/CoreVideo in).
2) Weak binds (--macho --dyld-info): _n2avc_vt_create and _n2jpeg_vt_create are 'flat-namespace ... (weak import)' -> dyld leaves them NULL while the packages are absent; every CoreFoundation/VideoToolbox symbol is '(weak import)' against its named image. So 'VTRegisterVideoEncoderWithInfo is NULL -> say so and return' is a real path, not a crash.
3) Ad-hoc signature: parsed both products. One CodeDirectory each, version 0x20400, flags 0x20002 (CS_ADHOC|CS_LINKER_SIGNED), hashType 2 (SHA-256), pageSize 4096; every page hash matches (plug-in 17/17 pages, probe 24/24). The signature is structurally valid, so if C1 fails to load the file it will be the path/process policy, not a malformed signature.

Current products: Slim.videoencoder 68416 B sha256 ee604d612c07932cc1baecbc72c6726763e91acbe1b75d3c9dd38bbf1238c3c2; n2vt_probe 95200 B sha256 f88d4c1fe9f54a026034e88a2dad1bf24c51ea0d7741c6da74cacc74e4942fc7. Commit fb4dc9c (build_ios.sh weak-library fix, kCFAllocatorDefault weak). WP01 suite still 31/31. Still open from WP08: kern/n2vk_dispatch.c needs <stdio.h>, and kern/symbols.txt does not exist yet; neither blocks the stage-0 plug-in because kern/*.c is only linked when avc/*.c exists.
